state.case_summary:
A woman in her 50s with morbid obesity and obstructive sleep apnea presented with 3 days of fever with a temperature up to 39°C, anosmia, and shortness of breath. Medical history significant for morbid obesity and obstructive sleep apnea.

Oxygen saturation of 85% on room air and coarse rales at the lung bases bilaterally.

- Laboratory Tests: Nasopharyngeal swab positive by reverse transcriptase–polymerase chain reaction.- Imaging Studies:  - Chest Radiography: Suggestive of bilateral multifocal pneumonia  - ECG Studies:  Title: Figure 1A - ECG in prone position  Description: Normal sinus rhythm with normal frontal QRS axis. Precordial leads showed low amplitudes and Q waves in leads V1 to V3    Title: Figure 1B - ECG in supine position   Description: Normal ECG findings

root.label: Acute Severe Respiratory Compromise with Fever and Multifocal Pneumonia
